articles.title: Meta is building a prediction markets app. These stocks fell in response
articles.description: The report said that CEO Mark Zuckerberg directed staff to develop a prediction markets platform, internally known as "Arena."

articles.title: Gold and silver tumble as rate-hike fears hit precious metals
articles.description: Gold and silver fell Tuesday as rate-hike fears pressured precious metals and Wall Street banks reassessed their gold forecasts.

articles.title: Meta announces new smart glasses starting at $299, as Zuckerberg keeps pushing wearables
articles.description: Meta executives have said they see the lightweight smart glasses as a step towards a more advanced device that includes screens in the lenses.
